articles.title: World's largest wealth fund posts $30 billion loss after bond market turbulence
articles.summary: Norway's sovereign wealth fund — the largest in the world — said Thursday that its investment portfolio delivered a loss of $30 billion in the third quarter, as rising interest rates dented returns on its bond holdings.
